stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Minor premiership form from Max O'Connell, 22 pts on the board and the rest of the field playing for second.

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Michael Avramovic picked up 21 spots, which is a top-four push in anyone's language.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Cheers to Kevin Hogg from Coolamon Sport and Recreation Club for making the drive, come back and do it again soon.

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 7 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 8, 9 & 10 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Fast Starter
stories.detail: Nine-plus out of the gate - 9 in the opening three

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 3, 4 & 5 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: 6th to 14th for Ronald Crouch, a ladder slip rather than a full rebuild.
